about: FRONTIER 111 (c), rail run 275, 2026-11-27: does basementstudio/xmcp#821's payer output reach a Cloudflare Agents withX402 seller set to network nano:mainnet through a Nano facilitator? Read as data only (blobless git clones at the pinned commits, and npm registry tarballs unpacked, never installed or run). Nothing was deployed, no seller or facilitator was called, nobody was contacted. test_cf_withx402_nano.py is a Python reading of the lines named here plus a stub facilitator and a stub node on 127.0.0.1, no key, no seed; its Table class keeps this file equal to what the tests show.

facilitator_calls.source: @x402/core 2.17.0 dist/esm/chunk-YEYZQZNL.mjs:856-990 (HTTPFacilitatorClient), schemas :774-805; default URL https://x402.org/facilitator (x402.ts:195-197), set by cfg.facilitator.url
facilitator_calls.supported: GET {url}/supported, read once per process on the first paid call (x402.ts:204-214, server/index.mjs:458-504); response {kinds: [{x402Version, scheme, network, extra?}], extensions: [], signers: {}}; retries on 429
facilitator_calls.verify: POST {url}/verify, body {x402Version, paymentPayload, paymentRequirements}; reads {isValid (required boolean), invalidReason?, invalidMessage?, payer?, extensions?, extra?}; a non-200 with isValid becomes a VerifyError, which withX402 maps to INVALID_PAYMENT (x402.ts:324-326)
facilitator_calls.settle: POST {url}/settle, same body, called only after the tool body succeeded (x402.ts:351-372); reads {success (required), transaction (required string), network (required string), errorReason?, errorMessage?, payer?, amount?}; the tool result then carries _meta['x402/payment-response'] = {success, transaction, network, payer}
facilitator_calls.auth: optional createAuthHeaders per path (verify, settle, supported); none by default

meta_keys.withX402_reads: request _meta['x402/payment'] first, then header PAYMENT-SIGNATURE, then X-PAYMENT (x402.ts:164-173); the value must be a string, base64 of the JSON payment (x402.ts:294, :299 atob)
meta_keys.withX402_offer: an unpaid call returns isError with _meta['x402/error'] = {x402Version: 2, error, resource: {url: 'x402://<tool>', description, mimeType}, accepts} and the same JSON as content[0].text (x402.ts:276-292)
meta_keys.xmcp_821_writes: _meta['x402/payment'] = an OBJECT {x402Version: 2, resource?, accepted, payload: {blockHash, orderId?}} (nano-payer.ts:9, :163-191); no base64 step anywhere in nano-payer.ts
meta_keys.xmcp_821_reads_offer: the offer object, its JSON text, or a tools/call result's structuredContent or first text content (nano-payer.ts:73-95)

cells.source: facilitator.pursekeeper.dev lists exact nano:mainnet in source (LOG 12:3xZ) but is egress-blocked from the cloud; x402nano/facilitator names no deployment and @x402nano/exact 0.1.1 verify skips the amount (LOG 12:4xZ); gosuda names none (LOG 12:1xZ)

overall.question: Does #821's output reach a withX402 seller set to network nano:mainnet?
overall.why: Two code gaps, neither closable by configuration: withX402 registers only the EVM scheme and exposes no way to add one (C4, C8), and #821 sends an object where withX402 needs a base64 string (C2). Behind them, the price is named in USD (C5) and #821 sends a blockHash where the two block-taking facilitators want payload.block (C6). The facilitator side itself is fine on paper (C7).
overall.what_would_close_it: cloudflare/agents: an option to register extra scheme servers (for example @x402nano/exact's ExactNanoScheme) and a price that is not only USD; xmcp: base64-encode the payment when the seller is withX402, or withX402 accepting an object. Each is a code change in someone else's repository, so 111 needs a pull request after all, not configuration alone.
overall.binding_note: withX402 binds a payment to the tool's requirements only (scheme, network, amount, asset, payTo; x402.ts:247-253, server/index.mjs:1323-1333): there is no per-call order id, so two tools at one price accept the same block until the facilitator marks it spent.
